weaknesses.name: Use After Free

weaknesses.name: Out-of-bounds Write

weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; bounded slice reads and adversarial truncated-tag/branch/underflow tests verify protection

weaknesses.name: Double Free
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: NULL Pointer Dereference
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; ownership and bounds checks prevent memory corruption

weaknesses.name: Integer Overflow to Buffer Boundary
weaknesses.reason: safe Rust: static analyzer proved no unsafe blocks and no FFI reachability; checked_add, checked_mul, try_from, and MAX_BIT_WIDTH <= 31 prevent integer overflow

weaknesses.name: SQL Injection

weaknesses.name: Path Traversal

weaknesses.name: Code Injection / Eval

weaknesses.name: Improper Output Encoding
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package performs no serialized protocol formatting with unescaped control delimiters [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Log Injection

weaknesses.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption

weaknesses.name: Decompression Bomb
weaknesses.reason: bounded CWS encoding via deflate and adversarial CWE-409 test confirms swf-container terminates decompression bombs exceeding 50:1 ratio [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Uncontrolled Recursion
weaknesses.reason: bounded traversal: iterative encoding loops and adversarial depth > 64 test confirms HierarchyDepthExceeded enforcement [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Inefficient Regular Expression (ReDoS)
weaknesses.reason: zero regular expressions: package contains no regular expression engines or pattern matching dependencies [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity
weaknesses.reason: bounded work per call: synthetic SWF bytes capped at MAX_CORPUS_SWF_BYTES (16 MiB), timeline frames capped at MAX_CORPUS_FRAMES (1024), bit widths capped at MAX_BIT_WIDTH (31), and VM steps capped at MAX_HOST_VM_STEPS (2_000_000) [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
weaknesses.reason: not applicable: no secret operands; non-cryptographic synthetic SWF encoder, deterministic corpus runner, and public SHA-256 frame digest verification. Recorded as an unapproved exemption because the registry defines no safe subset for CWE-208.

weaknesses.name: Use of Insufficiently Random Values
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package generates purely deterministic synthetic SWF corpus payloads and declares no rand capability

weaknesses.name: Use of Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
weaknesses.reason: no broken or risky cryptography: package uses FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (coding_adventures_sha256 via flash-player-host) solely for deterministic PaintScene and PCM frame digest verification [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
weaknesses.reason: no keys: the package takes and generates no key material; operands are synthetic SWF binaries, display scenes, audio PCM buffers, and public SHA-256 frame digests [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Concurrent Execution Race Condition
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package declares no thread capability and uses zero multithreading or shared mutable state

weaknesses.name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package interacts with no external filesystem or process state

weaknesses.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
weaknesses.reason: pure computation: package contains no dynamic object deserialization, polymorphic factories, or reflection [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]

weaknesses.name: Prototype Pollution
weaknesses.reason: strongly typed language: Rust has no object prototypes or dynamic prototype inheritance chains, and adversarial CWE-1321 test verifies Object.prototype modification is blocked [attestation not machine-checked by any tool]
